s.zh:
，拉洛克的古墓显露在世界地图上（离殖民地 6～15 格）。

古墓是石砌的墓室：外墙、几间墓室和中央大厅，守着骷髅、血肉巨像和半巫妖，最深处是拉洛克本人的化身——一名巫妖，会恐惧凝视、死灵冲击和生命汲取光环。卡苏斯之卷放在中央大厅的架子上。

踏进古墓，拉洛克的扈从就会与你为敌。古墓会一直在那里，直到你攻下它。
s.en:
, Larloch's ancient tomb was revealed on the world map (6-15 cells from the colony).

The tomb is a stone-built crypt: outer walls, several burial chambers and a central hall, guarded by skeletons, flesh colossi and demiliches; deepest inside is Larloch's own avatar, a lich with fear gaze, necrotic blast and a life drain aura. The scroll of Karsus sits on a shelf in the central hall.

Once you step into the tomb, Larloch's retinue becomes your enemy. The tomb stays there until you take it.

s.zh: 空闲时自动研读耐瑟卷轴
有心灵链接、智识 6 级以上、心灵熵低于上限一半的殖民者没事可做时，会自己拿起对他有用的耐瑟卷轴读（卡苏斯之卷 > 秘术残卷 > 研习卷，同类挑最近），最多读 2 小时。不想让某人读：禁止那卷卷轴或用区域限制。
s.en: Colonists with a psylink, Intellectual 6 or above and neural heat below half the limit will pick up a Netherese scroll useful to them when they have nothing to do (scroll of Karsus > arcane fragments > study scrolls, nearest of a kind first), reading for up to 2 hours. To stop someone from reading: forbid the scroll or restrict them with areas.
